result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured scope aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer stops it or `git-history.zip` from being written. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed-aspect config, so the fix is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip step near the end of the export. It used to read five hard-coded file names, and the renamed file didn't exist, so the read threw and the `git-history.zip` step never ran. It now builds the file name for each of the five aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`. That is the same helper that names the loose `aspect_*.txt` files. The entries are read and zipped in the same order as before.

With the default config the names are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) still reads the five default `aspect_*.txt` names as literals. I left it alone because the task was about the export.
